In June 2023, it was revealed that Japanese actress [[Keiko Kitagawa]], who previously portrayed [[Sailor Mars|Rei Hino/Sailor Mars]] in the 2003 live-action series, was cast as [[Sailor Cosmos]].<ref name="Sailor Cosmos">{{cite web|url=https://natalie.mu/comic/news/528734|script-title=ja:「セーラームーンCosmos」セーラーコスモス役は北川景子「本当に特別な作品です」|date=June 14, 2023|website=Comic Natalie|language=ja|access-date=June 14, 2023|archive-date=June 14, 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230614111102/https://natalie.mu/comic/news/528734|url-status=live}}</ref> Kitagawa was offered by the director and producers after deciding that the character should not be voiced by Mitsuishi, due to the character's solemn nature.<ref name="Kitagawa Casting"/> She questioned at first, because of the character being "an ultimate form of Sailor Moon from the future", and that it should've been given to her former co-star [[Miyuu Sawai]] (who've portrayed Usagi Tsukino/Sailor Moon in the live-action series), but took the offer after discussing with her former castmates, whom unanimously told her to take it.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://2023.sailormoon-movie.jp/interview/kitagawa/|title=Special Interview: Keiko Kitagawa (voice of Sailor Cosmos)|date=June 30, 2023|website=Sailor Moon Cosmos Official|language=ja|access-date=June 30, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Cosmos The Movie|script-title=ja:『劇場版「美少女戦士セーラームーンCosmos」公式ビジュアルBOOK』|trans-title="Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Cosmos The Movie" Official Visual Book|publisher=[[Kodansha]]|page=109|chapter=Cast Interview: [[Keiko Kitagawa]] (voice of Sailor Cosmos and Guardian Cosmos)|language=ja|date=August 2, 2023|isbn=978-4-06-532453-0}}</ref>

== Release ==
=== Japanese release ===
The two-part film was released in theaters in Japan in June 2023, with the first film on the 9th, and the second film on 30th.<ref name="June release"/> The Japanese Blu-ray and DVD was released on December 20, 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sailormoon-official.com/goods/bluraydvdcd/cosmosblu-raydvd.php|script-title=ja:劇場版「美少女戦士セーラームーンCosmos」Blu-ray・DVD|trans-title="Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Cosmos The Movie" Blu-ray and DVD|date=August 21, 2023|website=Sailor Moon Official|language=ja|access-date=August 21, 2023|archive-date=August 27, 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230827154217/http://sailormoon-official.com/goods/bluraydvdcd/cosmosblu-raydvd.php|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== International release ===
The two-part film was also screened in [[Shanghai International Film Festival]] in June 2023, as part of "SIFF Special: Toei Animation" line-up.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.siff.com/english/content?aid=101230528232105432646077380825093722|title=SIFF Special: Toei Animation|date=May 31, 2023|website=[[Shanghai International Film Festival|SIFF]]|language=en|access-date=May 31, 2023|archive-date=August 2, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240802154348/https://www.siff.com/english/content?aid=101230528232105432646077380825093722|url-status=live}}</ref> In June 2024, it was announced that [[Netflix]] acquired the streaming rights for the two-part film, and it was released worldwide on August 22, 2024.<ref name="Netflix Release"/><ref name="TUDUM"/>

== Reception ==
The first film failed to make it into top 10 in the Japanese box office in its opening weekend, but it ranked second on Filmmarks' first-day satisfaction ranking with an average rating of 3.85/5.0 based on 139 reviews.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.crunchyroll.com/news/latest/2023/6/13/japan-box-office-rohan-at-the-louvre-live-action-film-stays-in-top-10-for-three-weeks|title=Japan Box Office: Rohan at the Louvre Live-Action Stays in the Top 10 for Three Weeks|last=Komatsu|first=Mikakazu|date=June 13, 2023|website=[[Crunchyroll]]|access-date=June 13, 2023}}</ref> The second film debuted at number 9 in the top 10 in its opening weekend.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2023-07-06/2nd-tokyo-revengers-2-live-action-film-opens-at-no.1-in-japan-34th-anpanman-film-opens-at-no.5/.199934|title=2nd Tokyo Revengers 2 Live-Action Film Opens at #1 in Japan, 34th Anpanman Film Opens at #5|last=Hazra|first=Adriana|date=July 6, 2023|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=July 6, 2023|archive-date=July 6, 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230706085126/https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2023-07-06/2nd-tokyo-revengers-2-live-action-film-opens-at-no.1-in-japan-34th-anpanman-film-opens-at-no.5/.199934|url-status=live}}</ref>

Rebecca Silverman of [[Anime News Network]] gave the two-part film a B+ rating, and stated "The ending is both emotional and cathartic, bringing the story to a close that doesn't feel too final[…]but overall, this is a fitting way to end the reboot of one of the most influential magical girl series: with hope."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/review/pretty-guardian-sailor-moon-cosmos/films/.214919|title='Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Cosmos' Films Review|last=Silverman|first=Rebecca|date=September 1, 2024|website=Anime News Network|access-date=September 1, 2024}}</ref>
